sub_graphs.title: EIP-7773: Network Upgrade Proposal Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle states of EIP proposals as they progress through the Glamsterdam upgrade evaluation process

nodes.label: EIP Proposed for Inclusion
nodes.description: An EIP has been submitted for consideration in the Glamsterdam network upgrade

nodes.label: EIP Under Consideration
nodes.description: An EIP is being actively evaluated by core developers for potential inclusion

nodes.label: EIP Scheduled for Inclusion
nodes.description: An EIP has been approved and scheduled for deployment in the Glamsterdam upgrade

nodes.label: EIP Declined for Inclusion
nodes.description: An EIP has been rejected from the Glamsterdam upgrade scope

nodes.label: Evaluate EIP Proposal
nodes.description: Core developers review the EIP for technical merit, compatibility, and alignment with upgrade goals

nodes.label: Approve EIP for Scheduling
nodes.description: Core developers approve an EIP for inclusion in the upgrade schedule

nodes.label: Decline EIP Proposal
nodes.description: Core developers decline an EIP from inclusion in this upgrade cycle

edges.label: Author submits EIP for upgrade consideration

external_entities.name: EIP Author
external_entities.description: Developer or community member who authors and submits EIP proposals for network upgrades

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7773: Network Activation Coordination
sub_graphs.description: Models the activation process for scheduled EIPs across testnet and mainnet networks

nodes.label: Activation Time Pending
nodes.description: EIP is scheduled but activation time not yet determined by client teams

nodes.label: Sepolia Activation Configured
nodes.description: Activation time has been set for Sepolia testnet

nodes.label: Holešky Activation Configured
nodes.description: Activation time has been set for Holešky testnet

nodes.label: Mainnet Activation Configured
nodes.description: Activation time has been set for Ethereum mainnet

nodes.label: Configure Activation Time
nodes.description: Client teams decide and configure the activation timestamp for a network

external_entities.name: Client Development Teams
external_entities.description: Ethereum execution and consensus client development teams responsible for deciding activation times

ambiguities.text: The activation table contains empty rows for Sepolia, Holešky, and Mainnet with placeholder values 'to be filled as activation times are decided by client teams.'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume activation times will follow standard Ethereum upgrade sequencing: testnets first, then mainnet. This is a meta-EIP that will be updated as decisions are made.

ambiguities.text: The distinction between 'Considered for Inclusion' and 'Proposed for Inclusion' categories is not clearly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'Proposed' means newly submitted EIPs, while 'Considered' means EIPs that have undergone initial review and are being actively discussed.

implicit_assumptions.description: Client teams have the authority to unilaterally decide activation times for network upgrades.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Coordination failures between client teams could lead to network splits or failed activations.

implicit_assumptions.description: EIPs listed as 'Scheduled for Inclusion' will actually be implemented and activated as planned.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users and developers planning for specific features may face unexpected breaking changes or delays.
